Scope: Source-only application orchestration; category persistence remains fail-closed and uncertified
ImplementedComponents: Explicit DI registrations for SQLite and isolated MySQL startup

LifecycleAudit.Authorization: PageController uses ASP.NET Authorize and SessionState.RequirePermission(Create/Edit) before page mutation; protected pages require Moderate
LifecycleAudit.AuthoritativeRevision: ITwApplicationPageRepository CreatePageAsync and UpdatePageAsync commit Page/PageRevision and enforce expected revision
LifecycleAudit.PostCommitHook: PageController invokes category indexing only after successful create/update return
LifecycleAudit.Rendering: GET and historical rendering remain read-only and do not invoke category indexing
LifecycleAudit.DeleteRestoreMoveImport: Move follows edit; delete/restore/import require future explicit invalidation or maintenance seams and are documented, not falsely wired
LifecycleAudit.Cancellation: Indexing service propagates the supplied cancellation token through authorization, source, extraction, and repository calls
LifecycleAudit.AtomicityLimit: No shared durable transaction or outbox exists; source-only code does not claim page/category atomicity

Authorization.ImportAndMaintenance: Require explicit caller-supplied authorized context; no implicit allow-all registration
Authorization.ProtectedContent: Existing Moderate check remains before page mutation

ExtractionPolicy.NativeTightWikiSource: Not silently treated as empty; imported-MediaWiki extractor returns UnsupportedSourceFormat

RevisionPolicy.RepositoryCompareAndSwap: Required of future durable implementation; not claimed by fakes

DI.SQLitePath: Registered with explicit rejecting category repository
DI.MySqlPath: Registered with explicit rejecting category repository
DI.ServiceLifetime: Singleton, matching existing immutable renderer/import service registrations

Tests.DatabaseGate: Not invoked; no category authorization inputs used

SecurityPreservation.Lua: Production disabled; rejecting executor default unchanged

RemainingCertificationGates: Reviewed category schema migration and provider implementation
